description: Test suite for S3 storage backend in Mattermost, including bucket creation, timeout handling, directory listing, and MIME type verification for video files.

methods.name: TestCheckMandatoryS3Fields
methods.description: Tests validation of S3 configuration fields.

methods.name: TestMakeBucket
methods.description: Tests creation of an S3 bucket with a randomly generated name.

methods.name: TestTimeout
methods.description: Tests timeout behavior during bucket creation and file writing.

methods.name: TestInsecureMakeBucket
methods.description: Tests bucket creation with self-signed HTTPS certificates and insecure settings.

methods.name: TestS3WithCancel
methods.description: Tests cancellation and closing behavior of S3 operations with simulated timeouts.

methods.name: TestListDirectory
methods.description: Tests listing, writing, and removing files in a directory on S3.

methods.name: TestWriteFileVideoMimeTypes
methods.description: Verifies MIME types for video files written to S3 with various extensions.
